title: Intraoperative microelectrode recordings in human substantia nigra and globus pallidus during a social ultimatum game
description: Intraoperative single-neuron microelectrode recordings from the human substantia nigra and globus pallidus in neurosurgical patients undergoing DBS surgery while playing a social ultimatum exchange game. The dataset includes wideband microelectrode and macro-contact recordings at 44 kHz from 24 participants across 33 sessions, with task synchronization events. It supports investigation of how midbrain and pallidal neurons encode social learning signals.
methods_description: Alpha Omega wideband RAW streams (microelectrode tip and macro contact, 44 kHz) were recorded at successive electrode positions during DBS surgery while patients played a social ultimatum game. Int16 counts were scaled to microvolts and converted to BrainVision float32 format, with TTL digital input edges written as events.
